verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents some built-in automation. A rule's release plan or ramp schedule can roll out automatically over time, and one community report mentions email alerts when an experiment reaches significance. That is time-based and alerting automation, not a general event-triggered action engine; its targeting rules decide flag values rather than trigger actions. Missing for 10: user-definable event→action rules, documented triggers on product or app events (e.g. metric thresholds, flag changes), outbound webhooks or action integrations, and independent corroboration.
